tokens.name: bg

tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, photo placeholders, skeletons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.usage: Background of info badges and alerts.
